description: Smart Survival is a Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that improves survival gameplay with realistic mechanics. Campfires provide comfort-based healing, sleep quality affects recovery, and food buffs scale with nutrition. Designed to be balanced, immersive, and vanilla-friendly.
